## Requirements

| requirement | disposition |
|---|---|
| SIG-RQ-002 (owner) | every public task has a `/task/<handle>/` detail page carrying the K11 §5.3 blocks — status line, what's unknown (absence kind in plain words), why it matters, subject and place, what SIG already has, triggered by, suggested sources, records-request draft (named absence until RQ-04 lands the drafts export), closing condition, how to act, possible outcomes, history, related, technical details — each a value or a named absence; the `sig.task-page/1` JSON twin rides `/task/<handle>.json`. MET |
| SIG-RQ-008 (owner) | every dossier 'What we don't know' gap AND every typed-absence row resolves to the real task or campaign page for that gap — or names the absence, never a guessed link; the fixture retention + unmapped-devices gaps resolve to real pages, the unqueued gaps name it; no `/task/new/` route ships (the include keeps its 410). MET |
| SIG-RQ-009 (owner, also P36.35) | `/task/<task_id>/` serves the id-alias stub (0-second meta refresh + link, never a 404) AND the generated `redirects.conf` gains the `301 → /task/<handle>/` rule in every build mode — derived per-card so fixtures exercise the same seam the export's `task_handles_history` feeds. MET |
| SIG-UI-039/040 | cited — every new route is T1 zero-JS (`/task/**` owner → P36.62, contract `sig.task-page/1`; campaign detail under the P36.61 `/research-queue/**` entry) |
| SIG-ENG-042 | cited — an unhandled slug mints no route (fail closed); a handle/task-id collision is a build error; a redirect rule is emitted only to a target the build emits |
| plan cell decisions | `D-K11-1` (campaigns, not per-object tasks), `D-K11-4` (page never invents a reporting channel), `D-K11-6` (claim = priority, never exclusivity) — carried verbatim; no GATE DECISIONS rows added |

## What landed

- `web/src/lib/task-page.ts` — the RQ-03b page model: `sig.task-page/1` twin, the §5.3 block copy (agent-drafted, labelled), status line, trigger sentences, per-role how-to-act, `resolveGapLink` (subject + named-predicate match → task; predicate + member match → campaign; else the named absence), `taskIdAliases`/`taskHandleRows` (the `/task/<id>/` → handle rules, deduped against the export's artifact rows).
- Routes (all T1): `/task/<handle>/` detail pages + `/task/<task_id>/` alias stubs from one `[slug].astro`; `/task/<handle>.json` twin; `/research-queue/campaign/<handle>/` (field, class, place, count, why, OSM contribution + the honest MapRoulette absence, member list, shard note).
- Links-in: `QueueCard`/`QueueCampaignCard` titles now link to the detail pages; `WhatWeDontKnow` gaps and `DossierSection` absence rows resolve via `resolveGapLink` — the hatch IS the link when a task/campaign exists, the named absence otherwise (SIG-UI-079's second action).
- Redirect plumbing: `astro.config.mjs` feeds `taskHandleRows(cards, getHandleHistories())` (filtered to emitted targets) into `redirectRules`; `build-fixture-export.ts` emits `web/task_handles_history.json`; two fixture gap predicates aligned to the coverage vocabulary so the resolution seam exercises real matches.
- Registry/baseline: `page-types.ts` `/task/**` → owner P36.62 / `sig.task-page/1`; `root-absolute-paths-baseline.json` allow-lists the two new files' provenance pointerBase; `redirects.test.ts` allow-lists the alias stub.
- Tests: `task-page.test.ts` (10 legs); `research-queue.spec.ts` +6 legs (all §5.3 blocks, the JSON twin, campaign page, gap→task click-through, typed-absence row, alias stub).
